module: Auxiliary shift light LED controller. Splits the RPM range [minRPM, maxRPM] into steps (one per electric listed in outputElectrics) and sets each electric to 1 when the RPM reaches its step; above maxRPM (or engine stalled if hasStallWarning), the "flashing" LEDs blink and electrics.values.shouldShift becomes true.
notes: jbeam keys read: rpmRange (3000), engineName and maxEngineRPMOffset (maxRPM = engine.maxRPM - offset), hasStallWarning (false), maxRPM (7000 by default without an engine), minRPM (maxRPM - rpmRange), inputElectricsName ("rpm"), keepLEDsActive (true: the lower LEDs stay lit), flashDuration (0.1 s), outputElectrics (ordered list of the step electrics), flashingOutputElectrics and flashingAlternateOutputElectrics (electrics that blink in phase / in opposition).
Each step writes electrics.values[name] = 0 or 1 (numbers, not booleans); shouldShift is a boolean.
The stall warning exists only if engineName AND maxEngineRPMOffset are defined and hasStallWarning is true.
If outputElectrics is empty, stepCount = 0 and the rpmStep computation divides by zero (inf), with no effect afterwards since no step is created.

init.desc: Reads the jbeam keys and builds the RPM steps and the flashing LED lists.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: updates the step electrics, shouldShift and the blinking.
